title.narrative: Provision of urgent integrated Protection services in Wadi Halfa and Alddabah among newly IDPs affected by recurrent Displacement and at risk of Famine

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThe project is targeting a total number of 9,285 (6,430 women,940 men,1,195 girls,720 boys) IDPs and their hosting communities in Wadi Halfa ,Dongola and Aldabbah localities with integrated and lifesaving protection services . The project is developed on complementary manner as it will response to the urgent gaps in light of the closure of NADA previous SHF interventions in the area . The proposed activities are designed to meet the lifesaving needs and underserved services with focus on the protection needs of the deportees from Egypt and the new IDPs influx from North Darfur in Aldabbah. This intervention is developed on integrated protection approach to be delivered as one package including urgent and basic services to ensure effectiveness as well as value for money. Project team will involve women, adolescent girls, Persons with disabilities (PWDs) and other at-risk groups in relevant aspects of protection activities monitor and address the protection risks, support the provision of age, gender, and culturally sensitive multi-sectorial care and support for persons with special needs (PSNs). In Wadi Halfa Where Nada will work with the women with Disability Association(WWDA) to ensure inclusion of PWDs and build their capacity in protection issues and directly implement some activities under the supervision of Nada team The project team will conduct regular protection monitoring, exercises at project locations. CBPNs members and active community members as well as WWDA will be trained and actively engaged in the protection monitoring. ltbrgtThe intervention will provide protection specialized services such as case management to GBV and CP survivors and PSNs .ltbrgtProvision of mental health and psychosocial support services including provision of psychological first aid, recreational, social and life skills interventions for PSNs The project will enhance the capacity of the relevant service providers through training on Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse ( PSEA) , GBV risk mitigation, and response. In Dongola the project will establish one women and girls space (WGSS )/Community Center which will host all GBV activities. More importantly women and girls will enjoy a safe space served as entry points for GBV interventions , PSS support identification of GBV survivors disseminate GBV information, raise awareness on social issues, and provide recreational activities . ltbrgt As part of dignified Protection response the project will provide direct support through cash distribution and provision of cloths, mobility and assistive devices , personal hygiene kits or any other needs required by the beneficiaries .NADA has a strong technical capacity of applying cash and voucher assistance to GBV survivors – NADA team already trained and successfully applied the cash distribution. The project will conduct protection monitoring using the protection cluster tools .The project will reach IDPs and limited percentage of hosting communities to minimize the conflict sensitivities between the two groups. The project will applied the localization approach through enhancing the capacity of WWDA ,NADA team will support the implementation of some activities by WWDA(10 case management/10 Direct support/100 PHK and 5 PSS sessions). ltbrgtNADA emergency programming in conflict contexts is designed in an integrative manner to include security, gender, accountability, and protection principles, as well as conflict sensitivity in all interventions. The project's design took into account how the conflict would increase the risk of CP, GBV and Protection in the targeted states. ltbrgtlt/pgt
